summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting progress under the third tranche of its share buyback program, executed by Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG as manager. Purchases made July 20-24, 2026 brought the cash amount spent to €1,295,054,815.83, approximately 88.70% of the tranche's maximum. This is an issuer repurchasing its own shares — a capital return to shareholders under the EU Market Abuse Regulation framework. The program has no stated price per share, premium, or board recommendation. Watch for completion of the remaining 11.3% of the tranche and potential impact on share count.
